title: Beyond AUROC & co. for evaluating out-of-distribution detection performance
findings: The paper's findings are unrelated to religion. The key findings are that standard metrics like AUROC are insufficient for evaluating OOD detectors as they do not account for the separability of score distributions between in-distribution and out-of-distribution samples. The paper proposes a new metric, Area Under the Threshold Curve (AUTC), which better captures this separability, arguing it is a more practical measure for real-world deployment.
